title: add vpc control plane terraform: multi-az subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, peering, route53 delegation
author: Sofia Patel
description: Add Terraform modules and examples to provision the Private Control Plane VPC topology for multi-AZ deployments. Motivation: provide a vetted, production-ready Terraform configuration for customers installing Redwood Private in VPCs with Route53 delegation, VPC peering, security groups, and private interface endpoints to reduce manual setup and support variance between cloud accounts. This PR introduces a top-level module 'control-plane-vpc' which composes: 1) multi-AZ private subnets with configurable CIDR allocation and tags; 2) VPC interface endpoints for S3, STS, and ECR (optional toggle); 3) security group templates locking down control-plane ports (HTTPS, metrics, health) and explicit CIDR whitelist support; 4) VPC peering automation between customer VPC and control-plane VPC with route propagation and isolation controls; 5) Route53 delegation resources and example DNS records to support cross-account name resolution; 6) outputs and IAM policy snippets recommended for installer/bootstrap roles. The module is environment-parameterized (region, az_count, nat_mode) and includes sensible defaults for new customers while allowing advanced overrides for enterprise networks. Changes include new terratest integration and CI validation harness to run plan/apply against a mocked account. Upgrade notes: this is additive; existing private installs are unaffected unless teams switch to the new module. Known limitations: does not yet support cross-account AWS RAM-based peering or Transit Gateway integration - follow-up work tracked in ENG-2020. Checklist: [x] Terraform modules and examples; [x] terratest scenarios for plan/apply; [x] security review and SG defaults; [x] documentation chapter in redwood-private-installer/README; [x] automated smoke validation in CI. See related Linear items ENG-1987 and ENG-2020 for rollout plan and docs tasks.
